Format RiskMap Results as a Table

Source: R/auxiliary.R
to_table.Rd

Converts a fitted "RiskMap" model, cross-validation results or polygon predictions into a table that renders directly in Quarto, R Markdown, HTML, LaTeX and the R console.

Usage

to_table(object, ...)

# Default S3 method
to_table(object, digits = 3, col_names = NULL, ...)

Arguments

object

An object of class "RiskMap" resulting from a call to glgpm, a "summary.RiskMap" object, a "summary.RiskMap_cross_validation" object, or a "RiskMap_prediction" object (see to_table.RiskMap_prediction).

...

Additional arguments passed to kable.

digits

A non-negative integer giving the number of decimal places used to display numeric results.

col_names

Optional column names, replacing the default headers.

Value

An object of class "knitr_kable" that can be rendered directly.

Details

This function creates a presentation-ready summary table from a fitted "RiskMap" model or cross-validation results for multiple models. Use coef or summary when numeric results are required for further analysis. Numeric values use fixed notation with digits decimal places, except when scientific notation is needed to represent very large or very small values clearly. Values that are compared share one notation: the estimate and confidence limits of a parameter, and one metric across models.

When the input is a "RiskMap" model object, the table includes:

  • Regression coefficients with their estimates, confidence intervals, and p-values.

  • Parameters for the spatial process.

  • Random effect variances.

  • The parameters of the family that were estimated, such as the measurement error variance of a Gaussian model.

When the input is a cross-validation summary object ("summary.RiskMap_cross_validation"), the table includes:

  • A row for each model being compared.

  • Performance metrics such as CRPS and SCRPS for each model.

See also

glgpm, summary.RiskMap_cross_validation

Examples

data(italy_sim)

fit <- glgpm(
  formula = y ~ gp(),
  data = italy_sim[1:100,],
  family = "gaussian",
  messages = FALSE
)
to_table(fit)
#> 
#> 
#> |                         | Estimate| Lower limit| Upper limit|
#> |:------------------------|--------:|-----------:|-----------:|
#> |(Intercept)              |    9.323|       7.701|      10.946|
#> |Spatial process var.     |    4.849|       1.820|      12.924|
#> |Spatial corr. scale (km) |   39.015|       2.777|     548.084|
#> |Measurement error var.   |    0.179|       0.133|       0.239|
to_table(fit, digits = 1)
#> 
#> 
#> |                         | Estimate| Lower limit| Upper limit|
#> |:------------------------|--------:|-----------:|-----------:|
#> |(Intercept)              |      9.3|         7.7|        10.9|
#> |Spatial process var.     |      4.8|         1.8|        12.9|
#> |Spatial corr. scale (km) |     39.0|         2.8|       548.1|
#> |Measurement error var.   |      0.2|         0.1|         0.2|
